mapper.select:
select count(1) calc_value, TO_CHAR(a.collect_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') category from iot_collect_data a
and a.device_group_id = #{deviceGroupId}
and a.collect_time > NOW-7d
group by TO_CHAR(a.collect_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
select count(1) calc_value, TO_CHAR(a.collect_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd') category from iot_collect_data a where a.collect_time > now - #{days}d group by TO_CHAR(a.collect_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

select cid, uid, field, collect_value, collect_time, device_sn, collect_status, reason, device_name from iot_collect_data where
(cid=#{item.cid} and uid=#{item.uid})

choose.when:
select a.cid, a.uid, a.field_id, a.field, a.task_id, a.address, a.collect_value, a.grade, a.indicator , a.collect_time, a.device_name, a.field_name, a.device_group_Id from
iot_data_${entity.uid} a
iot_collect_data a
where a.field_id = #{entity.fieldId} and collect_status = true AND grade IS NOT NULL and grade != 'status' AND collect_time between #{entity.startTimestamp} and #{entity.endTimestamp} order by CASE grade WHEN 'fatal' THEN 0 WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'warn' THEN 2 WHEN 'notice' THEN 3 WHEN 'normal' THEN 4 WHEN 'status' THEN 5 WHEN 'indicator' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END
choose.otherwise:
select * from ( select a.cid, a.uid, a.field_id, a.field, a.task_id, a.address, a.collect_value, a.grade, a.indicator, a.collect_time, a.device_name, a.field_name, a.device_group_Id , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uid, field_id ORDER BY CASE grade WHEN 'fatal' THEN 0 WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'warn' THEN 2 WHEN 'notice' THEN 3 WHEN 'normal' THEN 4 WHEN 'indicator' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END) AS rn FROM
iot_data_${entity.uid} a
iot_collect_data a
where collect_status = true
AND product_code = #{entity.productCode}
AND grade IS NOT NULL and grade != 'status' AND collect_time between #{entity.startTimestamp} and #{entity.endTimestamp} ) as t where rn = 1 order by CASE grade WHEN 'fatal' THEN 0 WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'warn' THEN 2 WHEN 'notice' THEN 3 WHEN 'normal' THEN 4 WHEN 'indicator' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END
